description: State Rep. Vince Perez has been named a Co-Chair of Texas Together, the Texas Democratic Party's 2026 Coordinated Campaign — one of three statewide and the only one from West Texas or the border.

title: Perez Named Co-Chair of Texas Together (Sep 9, 2026) — Vince Perez
